findings.claim: RESULTS.json protocol.note says the V26 reference arms were committed before the first run in NOTES.txt entry 1.
findings.evidence: NOTES entry 1 (ec284167) names only 'the V26 MC and S8 decisions'. The exact mapping first appears in parse_results.py, committed at fbcd44de (00:24:35), after all runs (00:03-00:17): seq to MC@seq; t6 and t3 to MC@t6; dense to S8@seq/S8@t3; dense t6 compared A vs B. No PROTOCOL.json was written (disclosed). The choice is immaterial: B coloured verify decisions equal V26 MC@seq and MC@t6 alike (9689/9689 each).
findings.correction: State that the arm mapping was fixed in the parser after the runs and is immaterial (both MC arms give identical results); keep the PROTOCOL.json deviation note.

findings.claim: NOTES entry 2 says 'No assertion changed: every existing test names its check'; REPORT_KO.md section 6 says all existing tests set the check explicitly.
findings.evidence: tests/stage_clients_assembly_identity.rs:1034-1060 (configurations_that_cannot_work_are_refused) builds clients with AssemblyOptions::dense()/coloured(..) and no with_first_use_check; NOTES entry 1 itself lists this test. Line 1060 now builds the MC colourings in new(). The test asserts no check or count and passes in my run, so no edit was needed.
findings.correction: Say: every existing test that asserts on the check or its counts names its check.

findings.claim: The rustdoc presents MC as the cheaper alternative to the full check ('150 instead of 4096', '59 instead of 131072'; All costs n right-hand sides) but never says MC can cost more than n.
findings.evidence: My scratch survey ran CheckColourings::of on 75 random banded patterns (n 60-500, half-width 0.2-0.45 n): total_groups > n in 59, worst 111 RHS for n=60 (1.85 n). On such patterns the default first-use check spends more right-hand sides than All, which is also exact. Not a contract acceptance item.
findings.correction: Add one sentence to default_first_use_check/CheckColumns: total_groups can exceed n when the declared band is wider than about n/2, and then All is cheaper and exact. Flag this for the owner.

findings.claim: Acceptance 3 ('New tests: ... the default detects the corpus cases that MC detects') is met by a test.
findings.evidence: The CI-run test the_default_decides_as_the_multi_colouring_check_on_part_of_the_v26_corpus covers 527 of the 4846 cases. The full corpus is checked only by the ignored program v29_record plus parse_results.py. In the CI ignored-tests job, v29_record runs without V29_MODE and only prints usage. The builder labels the unit test 'part of the corpus'.
findings.correction: Report the full-corpus check as a one-time recording (reproducible with run.sh) and the CI test as a 527-case subset.

findings.claim: Summary: 'the only miss is the known rounding-limited case'.
